sections.heading: Public Reputation, Safety Concerns, and Gentrification

paragraphs.text: Reporting and resident advocacy highlight a persistent tension between community perception and media narratives. Local community leaders, including members of SouthSideCAN, argue that news reports disproportionately emphasize violent incidents and nightlife disruptions along East Carson Street, such as a July shooting at the Carson City Saloon that prompted increased police enforcement. Grassroots efforts continue to address the area's reputation while seeking to represent everyday neighborhood life.

“The story that typically hits the news is the negative one about the terrible thing that happened,” says SouthSideCAN member Cassandra Dixon. She has lived in the Flats for 14 years. Dixon was late to an August interview because she bumped into a TV news crew on East Carson. And, he adds, it’s not something new there.
